text:
Priya: Quick sync — microbeta scouting plan for the Inference Optimizer feature. Need recruitment funnel, success metrics, and the minimal scope we can promise partners before tomorrow's roadmap review. TL;DR: target 8-12 partners, 3-week pilot, must have telemetry & exportable evals. Thoughts? :eyes:
Sam: We can run 12 if most are low-throughput. Requirements from infra: model pinning, canary fallback, and per-org token caps. Also need to lock quantization profile per partner to avoid noisy perf regressions.
Avery: For feedback loops, we should require a baseline prompt set + weekly automated evals that run on their traffic. Add quality regression alerts tied to a baseline metric (e.g., F1 on labeled set). Want to provide a small labeling UI — would help triage false positives.
Luis: Recruitment + incentives: prefer teams with production intent (>=1 internal user story). Incentive suggestion: $500 credits + priority support (2h/week) + post-pilot performance report. Screening questions should include data residency and whether they can share prompts. Also recommend we avoid on-prem in this microbeta — too many variables.
Maya: Onboarding playbook: 30-min kickoff, sample prompt library, ingestion checklist, and a one-page SLA for expected behaviors. Here's a minimal intake form snippet we can use in the initial outreach:```
- org_name
- primary_contact (name + email)
- use_case_short (2-3 sentences)
- expected_qps / peak_tokens_per_day
- data_sensitivity (low/medium/high)
- can_share_prompts (yes/no)
- preferred_deployment (hosted/vpc)
- commit_window_weeks (3/6)
```
Priya: Agree with avoiding on-prem. For scope negotiation: microbeta should include hosted + VPC (no air-gapped). We'll promise model version pinning + a fallback variant, plus token budget and a telemetry dashboard. Not promising custom kernels or HW-level tuning.
Sam: Ops note — we'll enforce token budgets with rate-limiter rules and send webhook alerts when ~80% of budget used. Can add an automatic fallback to a cheaper model if partner exceeds cap.
Avery: Success metrics proposal:
- Adoption: 60% of partners actively hitting API within week 1
- Quality: no more than 10% regression on baseline eval across partners
- Value: at least 3 partners report integration as "reduces latency/cost" in post-pilot survey
Luis: Add retention/intent metric: at least 25% commit to next phase (Dedicated or Private) or provide clear ask for roadmap.
Maya: UX acceptance: partners should be able to run an exportable eval within 48h of onboarding and label examples in the UI.
Priya: OK action items:
- Sam: config for token caps + fallback (due EOD today)
- Avery: draft baseline eval template and alert rules (due tomorrow noon)
- Luis: finalize incentive copy and outreach list (3x high-fit candidates) by EOD
- Maya: produce intake form and 1-pager onboarding doc (first draft by tomorrow)
I'll collate and present at the roadmap review. If anyone has objections to no-onprem constraint or the incentive level speak up now. :sparkles:

oncall-bot: deploy-notify: microbeta-intake-form v1 published to /internal/microbeta-forms (status: success)
Sam: small ask — include a field in intake for expected evaluation prompts count, helps KV cache sizing.
Priya: good call, added. If no objections I'll lock this and use the outreach copy Luis is drafting. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
